name: BYD
overview: BYD is a Chinese automaker with a strong focus on electrified vehicles, including PHEV (DM-i/DM-p) and full EV (e-platform 3.0) passenger cars. Several of its models are exported to overseas markets.

name: Geely
overview: Geely Auto produces a wide range of passenger vehicles, including the Monjaro (Xingyue L) and Coolray (Binyue) SUVs, sold across multiple global markets.

name: Chery
overview: Chery is one of China's largest vehicle exporters, with models such as the Tiggo 8 Pro and Arrizo 8 sold in many emerging markets.

name: Changan
overview: Changan Automobile produces passenger vehicles including the CS75 Plus SUV and UNI-V sedan, with growing export activity.

name: GAC
overview: GAC Motor manufactures vehicles including the GS4 SUV under the Trumpchi (GAC) brand, exported to several overseas markets.

name: Great Wall
overview: Great Wall Motor is known for its Haval SUV brand and the Haval H6, one of China's long-running compact SUVs, sold internationally as well.

name: NIO
overview: NIO designs premium electric SUVs and sedans, including the ES6 SUV, and has begun sales in select European and Middle East markets.

name: XPeng
overview: XPeng produces electric vehicles including the G6 mid-size SUV, with expanding presence in Europe and other regions.
